findings: The original 6–24-second values are intervals from first successful-map diagnostic to first reset diagnostic: 23.864949 and 6.470154 seconds. They are not observed durations of fallback.
Outside-range session recreation was logged 1.577518 and 0.811647 seconds after the first reset. This orders messages, not the initiating seek/control action or an inter-process cause.
The two cases then logged 9 and 10 stale-fence HTTP409 responses followed by session-ended/superseded notices.
No recovered record proves a server route change, persistent HDR10 base output, spontaneous metadata loss, or what any person saw.
The November 16 seek-spanning mapper trace remains a counterexample to inferring persistent fallback from this reset diagnostic alone.
